displayName: Strength Save: cost anomaly - Cloud Functions invocations and instances

documentation.content: Cloud Functions (v2 on Cloud Run) traffic anomaly. Condition 1: all functions together served more than 600 requests in the last hour (baseline 2026-08-31..09-30: median 11/h, p95 22/h, p99 41/h, max 59/h). Condition 2: a single function runs more than 8 instances for 5 minutes (observed max 5 during deploy overlap; default maxInstances is 10, overrides up to 30, see functions/src/function-limits.ts). Check which service in Cloud Run metrics, then docs/COST-GUARDS.md.

conditions.displayName: Function requests above 600 per rolling hour (all functions)
Single function above 8 instances for 5 minutes (near maxInstances)
